description: List every account connected to Anaella (mailboxes, calendars, Google Sheets, Google Drive, Slack, Search Console, Analytics, ads accounts, Business Profile, Stripe, PayPal, social networks…) with its `platform` and `features`. An account id is the `channelId` of the other tools: pass it in do inputs when several accounts of a kind are connected, and as `channels` in social.post.create ("publish" accounts only). Pass `feature` to filter. Free.

feature.description: Only accounts with this feature: publish (can post), analytics (can report), inbox (messages, comments, reviews), tools (usable in do)

name: list_accounts
